name: matlab-cosimulate-sumo-simulink
description: Build Simulink models that co-simulate with Eclipse SUMO traffic simulator. Use when creating SUMO-Simulink co-simulation, traffic simulation, TraCI connection, vehicle-in-the-loop testing, or ADAS scenario validation with SUMO. Covers Server/Client setup, Reader/Writer/Actor block configuration, random traffic generation, ego vehicle control, and SUMO file creation. Also use when the user mentions SumoInterfaceLibrary, .sumocfg files, or wants to connect Simulink to an external traffic simulator.
